`@interface UIDataScale`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.core.data` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [UIDataScale.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/core/data/UIDataScale.java)

Annotation that sets how the interface scale of the UI bridge applies to a UI.

## Description

Without it, a UI follows the interface scale of its bridge.

## Learn more

- [The design canvas](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/design-canvas/#follow-the-interface-scale)
- [UIs](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/uis/)

## Elements

| Type | Element | Default | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| `double` | [limit](#UIDataScale-element-limit) | `1D` | Largest interface scale applied to the UI when `limited` is `true`. |
| `boolean` | [active](#UIDataScale-element-active) | `true` | If `false`, the UI ignores the interface scale and stays at a scale of 1. |
| `boolean` | [limited](#UIDataScale-element-limited) | `false` | If `true`, the interface scale applied to the UI never goes above `limit`. |

## Element details

<a id="UIDataScale-element-limit"></a>

### limit

`double limit() default 1D` 

Largest interface scale applied to the UI when `limited` is `true`.

<a id="UIDataScale-element-active"></a>

### active

`boolean active() default true` 

If `false`, the UI ignores the interface scale and stays at a scale of 1.

<a id="UIDataScale-element-limited"></a>

### limited

`boolean limited() default false` 

If `true`, the interface scale applied to the UI never goes above `limit`.
